description: Standalone Python FastAPI ML prediction microservice under ml-service/. Provides rate prediction (GradientBoostingRegressor on synthetic USA/Europe lane data), simulated fuel pricing/cost, and a 7-day demand heatmap + lane forecast. Self-contained; the backend (FEAT-002) proxies to it. Build-toolchain: pip + uvicorn; verification is py_compile + pip dry-run (no deps installed globally).
steps: Create ml-service/requirements.txt with exactly: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, joblib, httpx, pydantic (one per line).

Create empty package files: ml-service/app/__init__.py, ml-service/app/models/__init__.py, ml-service/app/routes/__init__.py, and ml-service/data/.gitkeep (so the model-persistence dir exists in git).

Create ml-service/app/models/rate_predictor.py: class RatePredictor with sklearn GradientBoostingRegressor. Constants: EQUIPMENT_MULTIPLIERS = {USA:{Flatbed:1.0,Dry Van:0.95,Reefer:1.15,Step Deck:1.1,Lowboy:1.25}, EUROPE:{Tautliner:1.0,Mega:0.95,Frigo:1.2,Flatbed:1.05,Coil:1.1}}; MARKET_MAP={USA:0,EUROPE:1}; equipment->int code maps per market; MODEL_PATH='ml-service/data/rate_model.joblib'. train() generates ~2000 synthetic samples: USA rate = 1.80*equipment_mult*distance*(1 - 0.00002*distance)*(1+uniform(-0.15,0.15)) ($ total), distance 50-2000 miles, fuel ~3.85+noise; EUROPE rate = 1.50*equipment_mult*distance*(1 - 0.00002*distance)*(1+uniform(-0.15,0.15)) (EUR total), distance 50-2000 km, fuel ~1.65+noise; day_of_week 0-6. Fit GradientBoostingRegressor on [distance, equipment_encoded, market_encoded, day_of_week, fuel_price] -> rate. predict(market, equipment_type, distance, day_of_week, fuel_price) returns {predicted_rate, confidence_low=rate*0.92, confidence_high=rate*1.08}. save(path)/load(path) via joblib.dump(self,path)/joblib.load(path). Expose a module-level singleton `rate_predictor = RatePredictor()`.

Create ml-service/app/models/fuel_estimator.py: class FuelEstimator, BASE_PRICES={USA:3.85, EUROPE:1.65} ($/gal, EUR/L). _fluctuation(date)=random.Random(date.toordinal()).uniform(-0.05,0.05). get_fuel_price(market)->{price,currency('$'|'EUR'),unit('gallon'|'liter')} for today. estimate_fuel_cost(market,distance)-> USA (distance/6.5)*price, EUROPE (distance/100*28)*price; returns {fuel_cost,fuel_price,currency,unit,fuel_efficiency('6.5 mpg'|'28 L/100km')}. get_fuel_trend(market,days=7)->list of {date, price} for last days using date-seeded fluctuation. Module singleton `fuel_estimator = FuelEstimator()`.

Create ml-service/app/models/demand_forecaster.py: class DemandForecaster, LANES dict with 15 city pairs per market reused from the mock-load lanes for realism (USA: Chicago->Atlanta, Dallas->Los Angeles, New York->Miami, Seattle->Phoenix, Denver->Houston, Chicago->Dallas, Los Angeles->Seattle, Miami->Chicago, Phoenix->Denver, Houston->Nashville, Atlanta->New York, Boston->Philadelphia, Kansas City->Memphis, Minneapolis->Detroit, Charlotte->Nashville; EUROPE: Amsterdam->Paris, Hamburg->Warsaw, Madrid->Lisbon, Milan->Vienna, Rotterdam->Frankfurt, Paris->Berlin, Brussels->Amsterdam, Warsaw->Prague, Lisbon->Madrid, Vienna->Budapest, Frankfurt->Munich, Munich->Zurich, Zurich->Lyon, Lyon->Barcelona, Barcelona->Madrid). get_demand_heatmap(market)-> top-15 list of {lane, origin, destination, demand_score(0-100 deterministic from lane hash), load_count(int), avg_rate(float)} for the market. get_lane_forecast(origin,destination,market,days=7)-> list of {date, predicted_loads, predicted_avg_rate, confidence} per day with a mild deterministic trend. Module singleton `demand_forecaster = DemandForecaster()`.

Create ml-service/app/routes/predictions.py: router=APIRouter(); import the three module singletons. Pydantic request models RateRequest{market, equipment_type, distance, day_of_week, fuel_price}, FuelCostRequest{market, distance}, ForecastRequest{origin, destination, market, days}. Endpoints: POST /predict/rate -> {predicted_rate, confidence_low, confidence_high, currency (USA->$, EUROPE->EUR)}; GET /fuel/price/{market} -> {price, currency, unit, trend:[7x {date, price}]}; POST /fuel/cost -> {fuel_cost, fuel_price, currency, unit, fuel_efficiency}; GET /demand/heatmap/{market} -> array of lane demand objects; POST /demand/forecast -> array of daily forecasts.

Create ml-service/app/main.py: FastAPI() app; add CORSMiddleware(allow_origins=['*'], allow_methods=['*'], allow_headers=['*']); GET '/' -> {'service':'truckbiz-ml','status':'ok'}; include_router(predictions.router). Add a lifespan handler (contextlib.asynccontextmanager) that on startup: if os.path.exists(rate_predictor.MODEL_PATH) -> rate_predictor.load(MODEL_PATH) else rate_predictor.train(); rate_predictor.save(MODEL_PATH).

Create ml-service/Dockerfile multi-stage: builder FROM python:3.12-slim, WORKDIR /app, COPY requirements.txt, RUN python -m venv /opt/venv && /opt/venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt. Runner FROM python:3.12-slim, create non-root user uid 1001, COPY --from=builder /opt/venv /opt/venv, COPY app ./app, ENV PATH="/opt/venv/bin:$PATH", WORKDIR /app, EXPOSE 8000, USER appuser, CMD ["uvicorn","main:app","--host","0.0.0.0","--port","8000"].
Create ml-service/.env.example with ML_SERVICE_PORT=8000 and BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:3001.
acceptance_criteria: All ml-service Python files compile: `python3 -m py_compile ml-service/app/main.py ml-service/app/models/rate_predictor.py ml-service/app/models/fuel_estimator.py ml-service/app/models/demand_forecaster.py ml-service/app/routes/predictions.py` exits 0.
ml-service/data/.gitkeep exists so the model-persistence dir is tracked.
ml-service/Dockerfile EXPOSEs 8000 and CMD runs uvicorn main:app on 0.0.0.0:8000 as a non-root user.
ml-service/app/main.py exposes GET / returning {service:truckbiz-ml,status:ok} and mounts all five prediction routes.
verification: Run `python3 -m py_compile ml-service/app/main.py ml-service/app/models/rate_predictor.py ml-service/app/models/fuel_estimator.py ml-service/app/models/demand_forecaster.py ml-service/app/routes/predictions.py` and confirm exit code 0.
Run `pip3 install -r ml-service/requirements.txt --dry-run` and confirm it resolves without error.
Confirm `test -f ml-service/data/.gitkeep` and `grep -q 'EXPOSE 8000' ml-service/Dockerfile` and `grep -q 'uvicorn' ml-service/Dockerfile` and `grep -q 'truckbiz-ml' ml-service/app/main.py`.
findings: Implemented FEAT-001 (plan section A): standalone Python FastAPI ML microservice under ml-service/. Files: requirements.txt (8 pkgs: fastapi, uvicorn[standard], scikit-learn, pandas, numpy, joblib, httpx, pydantic); empty package __init__.py (app, app/models, app/routes) + data/.gitkeep; app/models/rate_predictor.py (RatePredictor w/ GradientBoostingRegressor, ~2000 synthetic USA/EUROPE samples, equipment multipliers + market/equipment int codes, predict() returns predicted_rate + +/-8% confidence band, save()/load() via joblib, MODEL_PATH='ml-service/data/rate_model.joblib', module singleton rate_predictor); app/models/fuel_estimator.py (FuelEstimator, BASE_PRICES USA 3.85/EUROPE 1.65, date-seeded +/-5% fluctuation, get_fuel_price/estimate_fuel_cost/get_fuel_trend, singleton fuel_estimator); app/models/demand_forecaster.py (DemandForecaster, 15 lanes/market, deterministic 0-100 demand score from lane hash, get_demand_heatmap/get_lane_forecast, singleton demand_forecaster); app/routes/predictions.py (APIRouter + RateRequest/FuelCostRequest/ForecastRequest pydantic models, 5 endpoints: POST /predict/rate, GET /fuel/price/{market}, POST /fuel/cost, GET /demand/heatmap/{market}, POST /demand/forecast); app/main.py (FastAPI + permissive CORSMiddleware, GET / -> {service:truckbiz-ml,status:ok}, include_router, lifespan that loads rate_predictor from MODEL_PATH if present else train()+save()); Dockerfile multi-stage (python:3.12-slim builder venv + runner non-root uid 1001, EXPOSE 8000, CMD uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000); .env.example (ML_SERVICE_PORT=8000, BACKEND_URL=http://localhost:3001). VERIFIED: python3 -m py_compile on all 5 source files exits 0; pip dry-run resolves all packages exit 0. NOTE for later steps: the literal `pip3 install --dry-run` hits the PEP-668 externally-managed block on this Mac (env constraint, not a resolution failure) — run it with --break-system-packages or in a venv. FEAT-002 backend proxy should target these ML route paths exactly (POST /predict/rate, GET /fuel/price/{market}, POST /fuel/cost, GET /demand/heatmap/{market}, POST /demand/forecast) and set ML_SERVICE_URL (default http://localhost:8000). The rate model trains on first startup if ml-service/data/rate_model.joblib is absent then caches; data/ is gitignored except .gitkeep. Did not touch backend/frontend/helm/terraform/cd.yml/README (those belong to FEAT-002/003/004).
